content.text: /ext:medcp What is the most frequent diagnosis among women in their 50s in our cohort?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT c.concept_name AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count, COUNT(DISTINCT co.person_id) AS patient_count
FROM omop.person p
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
JOIN omop.concept g ON g.concept_id = p.gender_concept_id
WHERE LOWER(g.concept_name) IN ('female','woman')
  AND (2026 - p.year_of_birth) BETWEEN 50 AND 59
  AND co.condition_concept_id IS NOT NULL
  AND co.condition_concept_id <> 0
GROUP BY c.concept_name
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, diagnosis_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
